title: Compare complete and partial expression dispatch
description: You inspect the supplied if-chain and match evaluators without filling their TODOs.

steps.description: You define expression nodes and an if-chain evaluator. Its operator dictionary handles arithmetic, and its Neg branch evaluates the child before negating.
You read the existing match cases for Num, Var, addition, and multiplication. The wildcard raises ValueError for an unhandled node.

steps.question: Does a ValueError from evaluate_match stop the test loop?
steps.answer: The handler converts it into an ERROR string. The loop then compares that string with the if-chain result and prints its flag.

steps.description: You run both evaluators on the supplied trees and print each comparison. The TODO cases remain absent from evaluate_match.
You inspect the recorded rows: addition and multiplication agree. The subtraction and Neg rows report errors and DIFFERENT, exposing the current coverage gap.
